newsitem.title: USA: Three smuggled children reported found in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Three smuggled children reported found in U.S.

text.p: Three of 10 children believed smuggled into the United States from Latin America on false passports have been located in the custody of family members and are fine, U.S. authorities said on Friday.

They were located through the Virginia-based Centre for Missing and Exploited Children which broadcast a nationwide alert to law enforcement agencies. "We've received a flood of calls" on the case, one U.S. official said.
State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said the first child, a boy, was found on Friday morning by agents of the department's diplomatic security service.
Later, authorities said two more children were found. Two of the children were 14 years old and one was 8 years old.

Authorities said they were not yet sure why the children were brought into the United States. In the cases of the three found children, they may have simply been smuggled in to be with family members who are in the United States illegally.

But Burns said: "There may be several different motives for having basically stolen U.S. passports and attached them to little kids. And so it's hard to generalize at this point about why these people did this."
Passport fraud is typically associated with illegal immigration schemes but sometimes is connected to narcotics operations, terrorism, money laundering and white collar crime, he said.

Agents first learned about the missing children when they recently arrested Theresa Martinez, a 34-year-old Bolivian woman, at her Gaithersburg, Maryland, home. She was charged by federal authorities with being the "ringleader of a sophisticated false identity document vendor operation."
Seven other suspects, who allegedly obtained passports with fraudulent birth certificates, were also arrested and other arrests are expected, authorities said.

Authorities said Martinez, who has three children of her own and used several aliases, applied fraudulently for the U.S. passports with birth certificates she manufactured. At least 24 passports were obtained in this way.
